summary: Repaired and applied the SQLite v1→v2 migration on node1. The catalog is healthy after reboot, with original records preserved and schema_version=2.
actions_performed: Made the migration atomic with BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
Added price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (price_cents >= 0).
Tested forced-failure rollback on a copied v1 database.
Applied the live upgrade and rebooted node1 safely.

evidence.requirement: Atomic migration and delayed schema-version update
evidence.summary: The repaired script performs ALTER and version update in one transaction. A forced version-update failure rolled back the column addition and left an integrity-ok, writable v1 database.

evidence.requirement: Preserve IDs/descriptions and add constrained zero-initialized price_cents
evidence.summary: Products remain (1, Paper) and (2, Tape), both priced at 0; omitted prices default to 0 and negative values are rejected.
Two additional upgrade runs succeeded; the database hash and v2 data remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Keep installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remained installed through completion and reboot.

Healthy v2 baseline was captured, reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed from 03273aa8-4706-4e1c-a855-c6ae9635951d to 23d0e4db-2381-451a-a809-967cf7820eda, and post-reboot database integrity, data, constraints, repeatability, and system state were healthy.
